name: lean
description: Two skills, both steering by prompt. lean: response density and shape -- full coverage at low depth, written to be skimmed. admino: route a task's next phase to the cheapest model that can carry the uncertainty left in it. A hook injects the rules on every prompt and after each compaction.

transport.description: How subagents are spawned: unified (native subagents), claude-native (Agent tool), codex-cli (shell out), or auto

main_model.description: Model id for the main agent — the tier that keeps design and risk work

main_effort.description: Reasoning effort for the main agent: low, medium or high

sub_model.description: Model id for the dispatching subagent — the cheap tier that takes settled, mechanical work

sub_effort.description: Reasoning effort for the subagent: low, medium or high

mid_model.description: Model id for the middle tier (3-tier ladder only) — repo investigation and pattern choice

mid_effort.description: Reasoning effort for the middle tier: low, medium or high

density.description: Default response density: terse, default or full
